guidance:
Write the smallest complete durable execution contract for a bounded change, defect, or task, produced as `<Subject> - Agile Work Item`.
Always preserve the intended outcome, acceptance criteria, repository boundary, and verification approach. Add exclusions only when they clarify the boundary, defect evidence only when relevant, and risks, decisions, or assumptions only when material. Give provenance (`user-stated`, `repository-observed`, `agent-inferred`, or `unresolved`) only for material decisions and assumptions.
Use repository-specific files, commands, observations, and conventions when evidence establishes them. Do not invent missing facts, architecture, product behavior, or verification results.

outline.title: Document Status
outline.guidance: Status, work type, last updated date, and available originating evidence. Status is Draft, Under Review, Approved, or Superseded.

children.title: Status
children.guidance: Draft, Under Review, Approved, or Superseded.

children.title: Work Type
children.guidance: Exactly one of change, defect, or task. A change amends existing behavior or configuration. A defect is a broken behavior. A task is a scoped increment from an issue, diff, or notes that is neither a product amendment nor a defect.

children.title: Last Updated
children.guidance: Date this document was last revised, YYYY-MM-DD.

children.title: Originating Evidence
children.guidance: Issue, pull request, diff, commit, ticket, or notes this item came from. Name the source. Do not invent one when it is missing.

children.title: Decision or Assumption: {summary}
children.guidance: One material decision or assumption, its rationale and effect, and provenance exactly `user-stated`, `repository-observed`, `agent-inferred`, or `unresolved`. Omit routine repository facts and omit all instances when none is material. Replace {summary} with the decision or assumption.

outline.title: Intended Outcome
outline.guidance: In one or two paragraphs, state why this work is needed and the observable outcome that must exist when it is complete. For a defect, include who is affected and the impact. Preserve the approved intent without expanding it into a product vision or adjacent objective.

children.title: Defect Evidence
children.guidance: For a defect only, record available reproduction steps, expected versus actual behavior, and a confirmed root cause when known. Tag an unconfirmed cause `! [HYPOTHESIS]`. Omit for other work and when it adds no dependable evidence.

outline.title: Acceptance Criteria
outline.guidance: Verifiable criteria identified `AC-001` onward. Use Given / When / Then for an interaction, transition, or flow. For any other observable check, use concise declarative Target and Constraint fields. Add Violation only when a failure response or failure behavior is part of the contract. For a defect, each criterion is a regression check that would fail on the unfixed code. Title each instance with the behavior, not "Acceptance Criterion".

children.title: Acceptance Criterion: {behavior}
children.guidance: Replace {behavior} with the behavior. Use Given / When / Then for an interaction, transition, or flow. For any other observable check, use concise declarative Target and Constraint fields. Add Violation only when a failure response or failure behavior is part of the contract. For a defect, make the criterion a regression check that would fail on the unfixed code.

outline.title: Repository Boundary and Permitted Files
outline.guidance: Name the repository, modules, directories, and files this work may create or edit, using exact files where known and bounded areas where discovery may reveal the final file set. Do not include opportunistic refactoring or unrelated formatting.

children.title: Exclusions and Non-Goals
children.guidance: Material exclusions not already clear from the positive boundary. Omit when none adds clarity.

children.title: Risk or Advisory: {concern}
children.guidance: One material concern, likely impact, and established mitigation or follow-up. Omit all instances when no material risk or advisory is present. Replace {concern} with the concern.

outline.title: Verification Approach
outline.guidance: State how the acceptance criteria will be evaluated. Include the repository-native automated commands, concrete manual observations, or an explicit reason that a mode does not apply. Omit unused leaves rather than inventing evidence.

children.title: Automated Commands
children.guidance: Exact repository-native commands and the acceptance criteria each command evaluates. Omit when automated verification does not apply.

children.title: Manual Observations
children.guidance: Concrete actions, preconditions, and observable expected results. Omit when manual verification does not apply.

children.title: Not-Applicable Reason
children.guidance: Explain why automated commands, manual observation, or both do not apply. Omit when both modes apply.
